evidence:
RUNTIME FACTS (each launch assumption in tests/test.sh, which is byte-identical to the frozen template test.sh, traced to agent-readable text). Path: instruction.md:5 'Put the app in /app and serve the workspace at /'; integration.md:3 'Put the finished app in /app'. Start command and cwd: integration.md:3 'We start it with node /app/server.js from a working directory that may be outside /app. Resolve files from their actual location.' matches test.sh:97-111 (entry /app/server.js, or /tmp/submission/server.js when /app is not writable). Port and bind: integration.md:3 'Listen on 0.0.0.0:3000' matches test.sh:48,108 and every prompt URL http://localhost:3000. Health path: integration.md:3 'answer GET /api/health promptly' matches test.sh:48. Storage: integration.md:9 'Use SQLite for persistent records. The default database path is /app/app.db. If DB_PATH is set, open that absolute path instead, including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app. Keep the same records and revision history after a process restart.' matches test.sh:98-109 and the restart helper test.sh:160-167. Dependencies: integration.md:5 'The launch image supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH ... Include everything needed at runtime; opening the finished app must not require an install or build step' matches tests/Dockerfile (node:22, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules) and test.sh:106. Symlink rule: integration.md:11 matches test.sh:72-83. Seed: instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7 name /assets/seed_data.json and say it 'contains no user snippets or starter implementation', matching seed_data.json ('snippets': []). Accounts: instruction.md:5 'without signing in', policy.md:3 'without sign-in or private accounts', overview.md:3 'without accounts', matching app_context.md:10 'None'. Fixed clock: none stated and none needed; no criterion grades a date, age or wall-clock figure (the only time rules are the five-second run budget and the about-five-second library refresh, both stated in behaviour.md:5 and :11). Network: public, nothing to state.

GRADED => ASKED. I mapped all 3 gate, 42 functional, 6 polish and 3 visual criteria to public text and found no criterion that demands something neither stated nor a professional default. Spot evidence for the least obvious ones: Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End (cw_caret_kept_in_view) => ui.md:5; both Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click (cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic) => ui.md:9; burst independent of pauses => ui.md:9 'however slowly'; Undo/Redo controls disabled after New/open (cw_undo_redo_availability) => ui.md:9; caret restored by Undo (cw_undo_restores_caret) => ui.md:9; literal dot/bracket search, wrap, replace-current moves on, self-containing replacement (criteria 13-16) => ui.md:11; five JS and four HTML colour categories distinct from plain names, function name same at declaration and call => ui.md:13; two-space nesting, idempotent format, one Undo, format error keeps draft => ui.md:15; whole-file HTML error line and unhandled-rejection message and line (criteria 24-25) => behaviour.md:3; output kept before failure/stop/timeout => behaviour.md:3; last-good with typed values and canvas, fresh budget per interaction => behaviour.md:5; Stop and superseded run never write later => behaviour.md:7; stale save refused and dirty draft kept => behaviour.md:9; live library within about five seconds preserving draft/caret/scroll/Undo/title/filename and newer-revision notice => behaviour.md:11; read-only history, restore adds a revision, stale restore, repeated restore request adds none => behaviour.md:13; parent page, origin storage and fetch to own routes and outside addresses blocked => security.md:3; eval/Function/WebAssembly/Worker/dynamic import refused with feedback, harmless in strings and comments => security.md:5; own editing surface and named ready-made editors (constraints gate) => ui.md:3; storage-cleared reload still reads the record (cw_shared_saved_record) => behaviour.md:9 'A fresh page must read the saved record from the running app' and integration.md:7; keyboard exit from editor shown on screen, worded feedback after Run/Save/Format, focus back to code after Format/Undo/Redo/replacement/Save, unsaved marker cleared by Save and by Undo, 390 px usability (polish) => ui.md:17. Visual criteria grade generic craft of surfaces that are all asked for.

ACTUAL-RUN EVIDENCE. The scripted golden run on these bytes launched the reference exactly as the stated contract describes (run_golden.sh: 'cd /tmp && exec setsid env -i ... PORT=3000 DB_PATH=/app/app.db setpriv --reuid=65534 ... node /app/server.js') and reports every scripted criterion true with one real process restart (results/persist-after.json cw_save_reload_restart true; restart.json revision 2, history [2,1]). This supports that an app built only from the stated facts launches and persists; it is not a configured judge run on these bytes, and the only hosted run is on an earlier candidate.

RESIDUAL RISK (why risk=true; not a defect of the stated contract). test.sh:104-109 injects PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT and DB_PATH. The notes name NODE_PATH and DB_PATH but never the variable PORT; unlike the template integration.md ('listens on port 3000'), this task's notes do not even contain the word 'port' (only '0.0.0.0:3000'), and HOME appears only as the keyboard key 'Home' in ui.md:5. The workbook's Deterministic Checks row 31 and deterministic-checks.md:50 say 'every environment variable test.sh injects is named somewhere the agent can read'; quality-checks.md says that checker owns the mechanical half of this row. The private checker was not run, so whether it accepts these bytes is unmeasured. No builder can be graded wrongly by this (the injected PORT equals the stated 3000 and HOME is not needed), so it does not fail the quality row, but the deterministic reviewer should adjudicate it.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening, no behaviour change: in integration.md say 'Listen on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0 (PORT is set to 3000 at launch)' so the injected variable is named for check-runtime-contract-strings.py.
